summary: A mixed briefing dominated by regulatory developments and major retail/Reliance corporate actions. Key legal milestone with Mediation Council establishment; Jio IPO clearance represents significant capital markets event.

bullets.text: Central government establishes Mediation Council of India to strengthen alternative dispute resolution framework.
Jio Platforms receives SEBI approval for Rs 37,700 crore IPO, one of India's largest planned public offerings.
Pernod Ricard initiates legal process for potential India IPO, signaling significant expansion plans.
Croma parent Infiniti Retail narrows losses significantly, demonstrating strong turnaround momentum.
Supreme Court Justice flags inadequate SIAC arbitral appointments for Indian lawyers, raising professional opportunity concerns.
